body:
Design the **content** state of the My Accounts screen for **mifos-x-open-banking**, a Open Banking KMP super-app — consumer retail banking + field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7, built with Compose Multiplatform across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web.

Palette: background #12140E, surface #1E201A, surfaceHigh #282A24, onSurface #E3E3D8, primary #B2D188, onPrimary #1F3701, primaryContainer #354E16, onPrimaryContainer #CDEDA3, secondary #A0CFCB, onSecondary #003735, outline #8F9285, outlineVariant #44483D, onSurfaceVariant #C5C8BA, pending #E8A317, error #FFB4AB.

**Component 1 — Top App Bar** (56dp tall, full width): Title "My Accounts" Outfit SemiBold 20sp #E3E3D8, left-aligned 16dp inset. Trailing help icon 24dp tinted #C5C8BA. Background #12140E, zero elevation, no shadow. 48dp tap zone on icon.

**Component 2 — Search Bar** (full width minus 32dp insets, 48dp tall, top margin 12dp): Outlined pill Text Field, corner radius 999dp (pill), stroke 1dp #8F9285. Leading search icon 20dp #C5C8BA. Placeholder "Search by name, number or label" Outfit Regular 16sp #8F9285. Background #1E201A. No filter tabs, no chips below.

**Component 3 — Bank Group Header: Mifos Bank UK** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 20dp): Row — bank icon 20dp #B2D188, then column: name "Mifos Bank UK" Outfit Medium 14sp #E3E3D8, subtitle "2 accounts" Outfit Regular 12sp #C5C8BA. Subtotal "£10,430.50" Outfit SemiBold 16sp #B2D188 right-aligned. 12dp vertical padding. No divider above.

**Component 4 — Account Card: Primary Checking** (full width minus 32dp insets, 80dp min height, 12dp corner radius, top margin 8dp): Card background #282A24. Header row: label "Primary Checking" Outfit Medium 16sp #E3E3D8 left, badge "CHECKING" Outfit Medium 11sp #CDEDA3 on #354E16 pill 6dp vertical/10dp horizontal right. Balance "£4,250.00" Outfit SemiBold 22sp #B2D188 below label, 4dp margin. IBAN row: account_box icon 16dp #8F9285, IBAN "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00" Outfit Regular 12sp #C5C8BA, 6dp gap. 16dp all-side padding. index_list archetype card.

**Component 5 — Account Card: Holiday Savings** (full width minus 32dp insets, 80dp min height, 12dp corner radius, top margin 8dp): Card background #282A24. Header row: label "Holiday Savings" Outfit Medium 16sp #E3E3D8 left, badge "SAVINGS" Outfit Medium 11sp #CDEDA3 on #354E16 pill right. Balance "£6,180.50" Outfit SemiBold 22sp #B2D188. IBAN row: account_box icon 16dp #8F9285, "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0131 00" Outfit Regular 12sp #C5C8BA. 16dp all-side padding.

**Component 6 — Bank Group Header: Mifos Business UK** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 20dp): Row — bank icon 20dp #B2D188, then column: name "Mifos Business UK" Outfit Medium 14sp #E3E3D8, subtitle "1 account" Outfit Regular 12sp #C5C8BA. Subtotal "£2,050.00" Outfit SemiBold 16sp #B2D188 right-aligned. 12dp vertical padding.

**Component 7 — Account Card: Business Current** (full width minus 32dp insets, 80dp min height, 12dp corner radius, top margin 8dp): Card background #282A24. Header row: label "Business Current" Outfit Medium 16sp #E3E3D8 left, badge "BUSINESS" Outfit Medium 11sp #CDEDA3 on #354E16 pill right. Balance "£2,050.00" Outfit SemiBold 22sp #B2D188. IBAN row: account_box icon 16dp #8F9285, "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0132 00" Outfit Regular 12sp #C5C8BA. 16dp all-side padding.

**Component 8 — Divider** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 20dp): 1dp horizontal rule #44483D.

**Component 9 — Total Balance Footer** (full width minus 32dp insets, 56dp tall, top margin 0dp): Row — label "Total across 3 accounts" Outfit Regular 14sp #C5C8BA left, amount "£12,480.50" Outfit Bold 18sp #E3E3D8 right. Background transparent.

**Component 10 — FAB: Add Account** (56dp circle, anchored bottom-right 16dp inset): Background #B2D188, add icon 24dp #1F3701. Elevation shadow. 56dp tap zone.

DO NOT use em-dash anywhere in text. DO NOT make any headline >3 lines or any subtitle >25 words. DO NOT break the page theme between sections. DO NOT place light text on light buttons or dark text on dark buttons.

Scrollable dark surface #12140E. The earth-green primary #B2D188 on balances, section subtotals, FAB, and IBAN icons creates a financial-stability signal without shouting; the card surface lift from #12140E to #282A24 gives depth through border-based elevation consistent with the taste-default dial settings.
